name: Kaminagahime
source:
A Kaminagahime type monster girl. Kaminagahime means long haired princess and likely refers to the folktale of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rapunzel]Rapunzel[/url]. She can be found in the second playthrough and [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] finds this Kaminagahime being bothered by a Freedom type monster who cannot defeat her to make her his girlfriend. She considers her contract with Leo to be a marriage ceremony.

Because Leo cannot choose to have vaginal sex with her she will never become pregnant and has no child version.
